threat_event: Attacker persuades a division help desk to reset a privileged user's MFA and takes over the shared identity platform, reaching every division's systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 accounts with group-wide reset or admin rights, including 61 division help desk agents; reset verified only by employee ID and manager name (scenario gap 1)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; every federated application in all divisions
existing_controls: Hardware keys for administrators; SOC alerting on privileged role changes
treatment_plan: Division-scoped help desk roles; identity verification (video and manager approval) for every MFA reset; tiered administration in SYS-G1 by 2027-03-31

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared identity and network and exfiltrates data from several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity platform and one network hub connect all divisions; legacy segments at acquired clinics and the colocation data center
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3; SCSP; SYS-I2; SYS-I4; SYS-H1
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups in provider B
treatment_plan: Close the legacy trust; segment the colocation network; quarterly restore tests; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: Fraudulent bank-detail change redirects claims or vendor payments through the SCSP
threat_source: Fraudsters impersonating claimants, repair shops, or vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call center changes verified with knowledge questions only; vendor changes requested by email (scenario gap 5)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-I2; SYS-G4; SCSP integration services; SYS-G6
existing_controls: Positive pay; dual approval; validation against templates
treatment_plan: Out-of-band verification to contact data on file for every bank-detail change; 5-day hold on first payment to a changed account over $10,000

threat_event: Misuse of standing ERP superuser access leads to a financial misstatement or a SOX material weakness
threat_source: Insider or compromised vendor support account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 17 standing superusers including 3 vendor support accounts; emergency access not reviewed (scenario gap 4)
existing_controls: Quarterly certification; external auditor testing
treatment_plan: Move superusers to PAM with just-in-time access; review every emergency session within 2 business days

threat_event: Plan PHI in benefits exports is viewed or used by HR staff outside the plan administration unit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Benefits export lands on a general HR site open to about 140 staff; plan documents lack 164.314(b)(2) security terms (scenario gap 3)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5; SYS-G7 HR site; plan administration
existing_controls: Plan privacy official; annual HIPAA training for the plan administration unit
treatment_plan: Stop the export; move plan files to a restricted site; amend plan documents; add sponsor certification

threat_event: The insurers cannot show regulators due diligence and contract requirements for the holding company as their Third-Party Service Provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2017 intercompany agreement has no security schedule; no due diligence on the holding company (scenario gap 2)
existing_controls: Insurers' boards receive annual program reports
treatment_plan: Security schedule added to the intercompany agreement; SCSP affiliate assurance report (P09) delivered to both insurers

threat_event: A shared-services incident triggers notices that are missed or inconsistent (insurance commissioners, producers, group health plan, SEC)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix lacks commissioner, producer of record, and group health plan rows and has never been exercised across divisions (scenario gap 7)
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter; HIPAA breach procedures in Health Care Services
treatment_plan: Complete the matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Attacker who compromises an acquired clinic pivots through the legacy directory trust into the corporate forest
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-way trust from an unmonitored legacy directory; no SIEM coverage; legacy EHR patching behind (scenario gaps 1 and 8)
existing_controls: EDR on clinic workstations
treatment_plan: Restrict the trust to selective authentication now; remove it at migration to SYS-H1 (2027-03-31); onboard legacy logs to the SIEM

threat_event: SCSP integration services fail and the standby cannot take over within the 4-hour RTO, delaying claims payments and payroll
threat_source: Cloud region failure or failed release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby failed over in 6 hours in the 2026-02 test; no retest
affected_asset_or_process: SCSP integration services; BP-G12; BP-G04; BP-G05
existing_controls: Bank portal manual upload with dual control
treatment_plan: Automate standby promotion; retest by 2026-12-15

threat_event: The enterprise generative AI assistant surfaces PHI, consumer nonpublic information, or MNPI to users who should not see it, across divisions
threat_source: Workforce users (accidental) and attackers using prompt injection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6,000 pilot users; no sensitivity labels; assistant reaches deal-room exports and benefits files users can open; BAA scope for the AI add-on unconfirmed (scenario gap 9)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G7 AI assistant; SYS-G8 deal rooms; plan files
existing_controls: Assistant limited to email, files, chat, and meetings
treatment_plan: Group AI Standard conditions (P10): labels, site clean-up, BAA confirmation, Health Care Services restricted until confirmed

threat_event: An unowned service account with standing rights is abused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 112 of 1,240 service accounts lack a named owner
existing_controls: Workload identity for new integrations
treatment_plan: Assign owners or disable; quarterly certification of service accounts

threat_event: An HR or payroll administrator misuses employee SSNs and bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad HCM reporting rights for payroll administrators
existing_controls: Background checks; quarterly access review; SOC alerts on mass exports
treatment_plan: Masked SSNs in standard reports; export approval for full SSN reports

threat_event: Breach or prolonged outage at the ERP, HCM, or treasury SaaS vendor
threat_source: Supply chain compromise or vendor failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complementary user entity controls in the ERP vendor's report were not mapped
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 reviews; nightly exports to the provider B vault
treatment_plan: Map complementary controls; add exit and incident clauses at renewal

threat_event: Identity SaaS vendor outage stops sign-in for all three divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity provider for about 900 applications
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts per critical system, tested quarterly; cached clinic credentials
treatment_plan: Annual break-glass exercise across divisions; offline contact list

threat_event: MNPI on mergers or results leaks from the board portal or deal rooms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deal-room exports copied to collaboration sites; assistant can retrieve them (gap 9)
existing_controls: Board portal MFA and watermarking
treatment_plan: Prohibit deal-room exports to general sites; label MNPI; block assistant retrieval

threat_event: The Reg S-K Item 106 disclosure describes third-party oversight processes that do not reach affiliates' services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Item 106(b)(1)(iii) narrative drafted before the intercompany gap was known
existing_controls: Disclosure committee review
treatment_plan: Align the 2026 Form 10-K narrative with P03 results

threat_event: Business email compromise of an executive leads to an urgent wire request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Executives' email is a target; callbacks are required but rely on staff discipline
existing_controls: Dual approval; hardware-key step-up; callback standard
treatment_plan: Annual executive and treasury simulation

threat_event: SOC visibility gaps delay detection of an intrusion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy directory and legacy EHR send no logs to the SIEM (scenario gap 8)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC for onboarded systems
treatment_plan: Onboard legacy sources by 2026-12-31

threat_event: A hurricane strikes Florida operations while claims volume surges
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters, colocation data center, and most claims staff are in Florida
existing_controls: Cloud-first claims; remote work; provider B standby
treatment_plan: Annual hurricane exercise with Insurance; colocation exit plan for SYS-I4

threat_event: Health plan third-party administrator suffers a breach of plan PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrator holds claims data for about 92,000 covered lives
existing_controls: Administrator BAA; annual SOC 2 review
treatment_plan: Add the plan to the notification matrix; confirm administrator notice terms

threat_event: The annual enterprise risk report to the Office of Insurance Regulation omits a material cyber risk from shared services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Report drafted from finance risks; cyber risks added informally
existing_controls: Group Chief Risk Officer prepares the report
treatment_plan: Feed High group cyber risks into the 2027 report

threat_event: Resume screening in the HCM recruiting module produces disparate impact in hiring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature enabled by the vendor in 2026-03 without review; turned off 2026-06
regulatory_driver: Federal employment discrimination law (Title VII); Group AI Standard
existing_controls: Feature turned off
treatment_plan: Keep off until an impact assessment and bias test pass (P10 AI-008)

threat_event: A deepfake voice call impersonating an executive persuades treasury to release a payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Voice requests are possible for urgent payments
existing_controls: Dual approval and callback to numbers on file
treatment_plan: Add deepfake scenario to treasury training

threat_event: WC adjusters read clinic records beyond what workers' compensation law permits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adjuster role opens the full chart (scenario gap 6)
existing_controls: Access limited to network patients; weekly privacy monitoring
treatment_plan: Work-injury-only view; replace direct access with report delivery by 2027-03-31
